parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Chilliwack Proper

Chilliwack Proper West is used by the MLS® as a sub-area name within the City of Chilliwack, and the City has no published boundary for it. The nearest official description is the neighbourhood plan called Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, whose area takes in the established residential part of Chilliwack Proper taken as a whole.

As a rough guide, the part generally called Chilliwack Proper West is the section west of the downtown core, around Young Road, Corbould Street and the airport side of Chilliwack Proper. That is an orientation from the addresses of schools and facilities, not a City boundary.

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Chilliwack Proper West

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.
The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan covers this area. It is Schedule B2 of Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, which the City adopted on December 16, 2025.

The plan was first added to the 2040 Official Community Plan as Schedule D, through Bylaw 2018, No. 4533. The City’s notice for the June 5, 2018 public hearing says its purpose is to guide future decision making on residential infill development.
ALR: Published municipal records list no ALR figure specific to Chilliwack Proper West. City-wide, 67% of Chilliwack’s land (17,322 hectares) is in the Agricultural Land Reserve.

Flood: Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519, the City’s bylaw, requires habitable floor space in areas with standard dike protection to sit no lower than the applicable Flood Construction Level, with 0.6 m of freeboard added.
The City is running a $30 million program, still under way, to bring the dyke system up to the provincial elevation as it stands now, and the Young Road dyke has already received its upgrade.

As an MLS® sub-area name, Chilliwack Proper West has no boundary published by the City. The closest official description is that of the City’s Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan.
As a rough guide, it is the section west of the downtown core, around Young Road, Corbould Street and the airport side of Chilliwack Proper.
This describes the area by addresses and is not an official City boundary, so ask me whether a particular address falls inside it.
How do I get around from Chilliwack Proper West?
Route 52 Evans runs from the Downtown Exchange through the Young Road south and Evans Road corridor.
BC Transit’s Route 59 Industrial links Downtown Chilliwack with Cottonwood Mall by way of the Lickman Park and Ride, and its page lists weekday trips in the peak periods only.
Route 57 Broadway has timing points near the airport and at Young Road on its run from the Downtown Exchange.

The regional Route 66 Fraser Valley Express connects Chilliwack with Lougheed Town Centre Station, going by way of McCallum Park and Ride, Highstreet Exchange and Carvolth Exchange. In Chilliwack it stops at the Lickman Park and Ride, Vedder Rd at Luckakuck Way and Downtown Chilliwack.
Which schools are near Chilliwack Proper West?

Bernard Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5, 45465 Bernard Ave), Central Elementary Community School (kindergarten to grade 5, 9435 Young Rd), McCammon Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5, 9601 Hamilton St) and Leary Integrated Arts and Technology Elementary (kindergarten to grade 5, 9320 Walden St).
Kwíyeqel Secondary (grades 9 to 12) is at 8855 Elm Dr.
Chilliwack Middle School, Chilliwack Secondary School and Imagine High are on Yale Road in the central part of Chilliwack Proper.

What recreation, parks and library are near Chilliwack Proper West?

Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre is at Unit #1, 9145 Corbould St, with a wave pool, a lazy river, an eight-lane 25-metre competition pool, a fitness centre, an outdoor water playground, a skateboard park and a pump track.
Hope River Corbould Park is at 9899 Corbould St, and Evergreen Hall is at 9291 Corbould St.
The Chilliwack Library is at 45860 First Avenue, in the downtown core.
What plan covers Chilliwack Proper West?
The Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, now Schedule B2 of Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500.
The plan is about residential infill development.
Is Chilliwack Proper West in a floodplain?

The City’s Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 4519 sets a rule for areas protected by a standard dike: habitable floor space has to be set at or over the Flood Construction Level that applies, with 0.6 m of freeboard on top.
Chilliwack’s dyke system is being raised under an ongoing $30 million City program, and the dyke at Young Road is now upgraded.
Floodplain status is set by address, so ask me or the City about a specific lot.
